environmentClassification: local env configured hosted Neon database; test/staging/production linkage unverified

raw.attendance_reason: Office Wi-Fi arrival confirmed by GPS

view.definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.event_uuid,
    e.attendance_id,
    e.user_id,
    e.company_id,
    e.user_device_id,
    e.device_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.device_event_time,
    e.server_received_at,
    e.latitude,
    e.longitude,
    e.accuracy_meters,
    e.inside_geofence,
    e.beacon_detected,
    e.beacon_id,
    e.beacon_rssi,
    e.wifi_verified,
    e.wifi_bssid,
    e.created_by,
    e.created_at,
    e.updated_by,
    e.updated_at,
    e.is_active,
    e.time_anchor_id,
    e.event_elapsed_realtime_ms,
    e.effective_event_time,
    e.time_drift_seconds,
    e.time_source,
    e.time_confidence,
    e.attendance_location_id,
    e.wifi_ssid,
    e.on_duty_bypass,
    e.presence_lost_at,
    e.metadata,
    e.arrival_candidate_id,
    e.presence_verified_at,
    e.attendance_reason,
    'DEVICE'::text AS event_origin,
    NULL::uuid AS regularization_request_id
   FROM attendance_events e
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM attendance_regularization_events r
          WHERE r.replaces_event_uuid = e.event_uuid))
UNION ALL
 SELECT accepted.id,
    accepted.event_uuid,
    accepted.attendance_id,
    accepted.user_id,
    accepted.company_id,
    accepted.user_device_id,
    accepted.device_id,
    accepted.event_type,
    accepted.device_event_time,
    accepted.server_received_at,
    accepted.latitude,
    accepted.longitude,
    accepted.accuracy_meters,
    accepted.inside_geofence,
    accepted.beacon_detected,
    accepted.beacon_id,
    accepted.beacon_rssi,
    accepted.wifi_verified,
    accepted.wifi_bssid,
    accepted.created_by,
    accepted.created_at,
    accepted.updated_by,
    accepted.updated_at,
    accepted.is_active,
    accepted.time_anchor_id,
    accepted.event_elapsed_realtime_ms,
    accepted.effective_event_time,
    accepted.time_drift_seconds,
    accepted.time_source,
    accepted.time_confidence,
    accepted.attendance_location_id,
    accepted.wifi_ssid,
    accepted.on_duty_bypass,
    accepted.presence_lost_at,
    accepted.metadata,
    accepted.arrival_candidate_id,
    accepted.presence_verified_at,
    accepted.attendance_reason,
    'REGULARIZATION'::text AS event_origin,
    r.request_id AS regularization_request_id
   FROM attendance_regularization_events r
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_record(NULL::attendance_events, jsonb_build_object('id', - r.id, 'event_uuid', r.request_id, 'attendance_id', r.attendance_id, 'user_id', r.user_id, 'company_id', r.company_id, 'event_type', r.event_type, 'effective_event_time', r.effective_event_time, 'server_received_at', r.applied_at, 'attendance_location_id', r.attendance_location_id, 'created_by', r.approved_by, 'created_at', r.applied_at, 'updated_by', r.applied_by, 'updated_at', r.applied_at, 'is_active', true)) accepted(id, event_uuid, attendance_id, user_id, company_id, user_device_id, device_id, event_type, device_event_time, server_received_at, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, inside_geofence, beacon_detected, beacon_id, beacon_rssi, wifi_verified, wifi_bssid, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_active, time_anchor_id, event_elapsed_realtime_ms, effective_event_time, time_drift_seconds, time_source, time_confidence, attendance_location_id, wifi_ssid, on_duty_bypass, presence_lost_at, metadata, arrival_candidate_id, presence_verified_at, attendance_reason)
  WHERE r.action <> 'VOID'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM attendance_regularization_events newer
          WHERE newer.replaces_event_uuid = r.request_id))
UNION ALL
 SELECT accepted.id,
    accepted.event_uuid,
    accepted.attendance_id,
    accepted.user_id,
    accepted.company_id,
    accepted.user_device_id,
    accepted.device_id,
    accepted.event_type,
    accepted.device_event_time,
    accepted.server_received_at,
    accepted.latitude,
    accepted.longitude,
    accepted.accuracy_meters,
    accepted.inside_geofence,
    accepted.beacon_detected,
    accepted.beacon_id,
    accepted.beacon_rssi,
    accepted.wifi_verified,
    accepted.wifi_bssid,
    accepted.created_by,
    accepted.created_at,
    accepted.updated_by,
    accepted.updated_at,
    accepted.is_active,
    accepted.time_anchor_id,
    accepted.event_elapsed_realtime_ms,
    accepted.effective_event_time,
    accepted.time_drift_seconds,
    accepted.time_source,
    accepted.time_confidence,
    accepted.attendance_location_id,
    accepted.wifi_ssid,
    accepted.on_duty_bypass,
    accepted.presence_lost_at,
    accepted.metadata,
    accepted.arrival_candidate_id,
    accepted.presence_verified_at,
    accepted.attendance_reason,
    'SYSTEM_DAY_END'::text AS event_origin,
    NULL::uuid AS regularization_request_id
   FROM attendance_day_closures c
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_record(NULL::attendance_events, jsonb_build_object('id', (- '1000000000000'::bigint) - c.attendance_id, 'event_uuid', c.event_uuid, 'attendance_id', c.attendance_id, 'user_id', c.user_id, 'company_id', c.company_id, 'event_type', 'CHECK_OUT', 'effective_event_time', c.effective_event_time, 'server_received_at', c.recorded_at, 'created_at', c.recorded_at, 'is_active', true, 'attendance_reason', c.reason, 'time_source', 'SERVER_DAY_END_POLICY', 'time_confidence', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED', 'metadata', jsonb_build_object('requiresReview', true, 'physicalDepartureConfirmed', false, 'workDate', c.work_date))) accepted(id, event_uuid, attendance_id, user_id, company_id, user_device_id, device_id, event_type, device_event_time, server_received_at, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, inside_geofence, beacon_detected, beacon_id, beacon_rssi, wifi_verified, wifi_bssid, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_active, time_anchor_id, event_elapsed_realtime_ms, effective_event_time, time_drift_seconds, time_source, time_confidence, attendance_location_id, wifi_ssid, on_duty_bypass, presence_lost_at, metadata, arrival_candidate_id, presence_verified_at, attendance_reason)
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM attendance_regularization_events r
          WHERE r.replaces_event_uuid = c.event_uuid)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM attendance_events e
          WHERE e.attendance_id = c.attendance_id AND e.is_active = true AND e.event_type::text = 'CHECK_OUT'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM attendance_regularization_events r
                  WHERE r.replaces_event_uuid = e.event_uuid)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM attendance_regularization_events r
          WHERE r.attendance_id = c.attendance_id AND r.action <> 'VOID'::text AND r.event_type = 'CHECK_OUT'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM attendance_regularization_events newer
                  WHERE newer.replaces_event_uuid = r.request_id))));
